rules: Neutral expression, mouth closed, eyes open and clearly visible
No head covering except for religious or medical reasons
Plain background in a light colour (white, cream, ivory, or light grey)
No shadows on the face or background
Photo must be less than 1 month old
Colour only — black and white photos are rejected
If you print it, use good-quality matte photo paper — glossy or textured paper is rejected
Glasses are allowed only if both eyes are fully visible with no glare or reflection
No mirror images — some phone front cameras flip selfies left to right
research_notes: 2026-10-02: re-read HMPO 'Photo standards' v51.0 (updated 4 March 2026). Confirmed 35x45mm, head 29-34mm crown to chin, eyes in the top 40-70% band (= 30-60% from bottom), any plain light background, last month. Background editing to remove shadows/marks is explicitly accepted if the likeness is unaffected; home-taken photos and selfies accepted. Added colour-only, matte paper, glasses and mirror-image rules from the same page. SpecShot's camera saves the unmirrored frame (components/CameraCapture.tsx).
